definitions.explanation: A detailed proposal or intention for doing or achieving something.
When used as a suru verb, means 'to plan' or 'to scheme.'

examples.japanese: {計画|けいかく}を{立|た}てましょう。
examples.notes: {計画|けいかく}を{立|た}てる is a common collocation

examples.japanese: {計画|けいかく}どおりに{進|すす}んでいます。
examples.english: Things are proceeding according to plan.

examples.japanese: {無理|むり}な{計画|けいかく}を{立|た}てると、{途中|とちゅう}であきらめてしまう。
examples.english: If you make an unreasonable plan, you'll end up giving up partway through.

examples.japanese: {旅行|りょこう}を{計画|けいかく}している。
{友達|ともだち}と{一緒|いっしょ}にイベントを{計画|けいかく}した。
examples.english: I planned an event together with my friends.

examples.japanese: {来年|らいねん}の{夏|なつ}に{海外旅行|かいがいりょこう}を{計画|けいかく}しているが、まだ{行|い}き{先|さき}が{決|き}まっていない。
examples.english: I'm planning an overseas trip next summer, but I haven't decided on the destination yet.

notes:
{計画|けいかく} refers to plans, projects, or schemes. Can function as a noun or suru verb.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {計画|けいかく}を{立|た}てる: to make a plan
- {計画|けいかく}どおり: according to plan
- {計画|けいかく}を{実行|じっこう}する: to execute a plan
- {計画的|けいかくてき}に: systematically, in a planned manner

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {予定|よてい}: schedule (more concrete, time-based)
- つもり: intention (personal, informal)
- {企画|きかく}: project, planning (often business/creative)

NOTE: {計画|けいかく}する means "to plan" as a verb.
